name: Static Image Display
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Display static images on your LED matrix with automatic scaling, aspect ratio preservation, and transparency support. Perfect for logos, artwork, or custom graphics.

versions.notes: Correct the README config docs: document all rotation_mode values (sequential/random/time_based/date_based), describe images as scheduled image entries rather than plain paths, and add a Per-Image Scheduling section. Normalize the versions changelog key to ledmatrix_min.
